SELECT current_orders.id AS current_orders_id, current_orders.order_id AS current_orders_order_id, current_orders.merchant_id AS current_orders_merchant_id, current_orders.status AS current_orders_status, current_orders.time_of_arrival AS current_orders_time_of_arrival, current_orders.delivery_fee AS current_orders_delivery_fee, current_orders.image AS current_orders_image, current_orders.created_at AS current_orders_created_at FROM current_orders JOIN orders ON orders.id = current_orders.order_id JOIN order_histories ON order_histories.id = orders.order_history_id WHERE order_histories.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::INTEGER ORDER BY current_orders.id ASC

SELECT orders.id, orders.order_history_id, orders.user_id, orders.merchant_id, orders.status, orders.total_price, orders.items, orders.delivery_address, orders.ordered_at, orders.shipment_id, orders.shipped_at, orders.delivered_at, orders.delivery_confirmed_by, orders.route_waypoints FROM orders WHERE %(param_1)s::INTEGER = orders.order_history_id

SELECT orders.id AS orders_id, orders.order_history_id AS orders_order_history_id, orders.user_id AS orders_user_id, orders.merchant_id AS orders_merchant_id, orders.status AS orders_status, orders.total_price AS orders_total_price, orders.items AS orders_items, orders.delivery_address AS orders_delivery_address, orders.ordered_at AS orders_ordered_at, orders.shipment_id AS orders_shipment_id, orders.shipped_at AS orders_shipped_at, orders.delivered_at AS orders_delivered_at, orders.delivery_confirmed_by AS orders_delivery_confirmed_by, orders.route_waypoints AS orders_route_waypoints FROM orders JOIN order_histories ON order_histories.id = orders.order_history_id WHERE orders.id = %(id_1)s::INTEGER AND order_histories.user_id = %(user_id_1)s::INTEGER LIMIT %(param_1)s::INTEGER
